tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat tone 低平调) three times in a row. Low and flat, not mid like 試 si3.
tasks.script: 事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6 (compare: 試 si3 is mid-level; 事 si6 sits lower)

tasks.title: How to Study Korean · Unit 0 Lesson 2 (syllable blocks) · skim only if café lines feel fuzzy
Read aloud: café orders with 주세요

lines.translation: Hello. The menu, please. · 你好。请给我菜单。
Iced americano, please. · 请来杯冰美式。
This one, please. How much? · 请给我这个。多少钱？
Delicious! The bill, please. Thank you. · 好吃！请结账。谢谢。

tasks.prompt: Write ×3 then say: 주세요 · 맛있어요 · 한국어. Then one breath: Point → Reason → Example on why 맛있어요 sounds like ma-si-sseo-yo (연음).
tasks.script: Writing: 주세요 주세요 주세요 · 맛있어요 맛있어요 맛있어요 · 한국어 한국어 한국어. Explanation: "Point: 맛있어요 links. Reason: the final ㅅ of 맛 moves onto the next vowel. Example: 맛 + 있어요 → ma-si-sseo-yo, same linking idea as 맛있다 → ma-si-tta."

questions.explain: X 주세요 = please give me X. Thank you = 감사합니다; just a moment = 잠시만요.

questions.q: Tue weak spot: 밥 romanises as…
questions.explain: ㅂ at the bottom = p → bap. You missed this on Tue.

questions.q: ㅅ at the bottom of a block (like 옷) sounds like…
questions.explain: Final ㅅ → t. Recycle from Tue quiz miss.
한국 = Korea; 한국어 = Korean language. ㄱ links into the next vowel.
짜다 = salty (tense ㅉ). Cheap = 싸다; apartment = 아파트.
